title: arbitration
description: The product owner's binding ruling on one feedback item the engineer and a tester could not settle between themselves. A violation of a rules file can never be ruled in the engineer's favour.

type.description: Omit this. The orchestrator stamps it when it stores the message.

item_id.description: The id of the disputed feedback item, copied exactly.

ruling.description: uphold_tester: the engineer must address the item. uphold_engineer: the item is overruled and stops blocking. compromise: the engineer follows your instruction instead.

instruction.description: What the engineer must do now. Required for compromise.

rationale.description: Why you ruled this way, addressed to both agents.

then.$comment: A compromise is only actionable with the instruction that replaces both positions.
